name: King & Courtesan
author: Mark Steere (2022) / AGP port
description: King & Courtesan (Mark Steere, 2022) on a checkerboard turned 45 degrees, so the first 'row' is a single square: the home square. Each side fills the triangle around its own corner with a king (a stack of two checkers) and courtesans. Any piece steps one square forward to an empty square, or captures by replacement in any of the eight directions; the king may instead swap places with an adjacent forward courtesan. Win by landing your king on the enemy home square, or by capturing the enemy king. Hard-finite: no cycle is possible and there are no draws.
